subject: Post-call: Private deployment, vendor SQ initiation & network isolation options
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Wang <oliver.wang@finserve.com>, Erin Chen <erin.chen@finserve.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-25 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Private deployment, vendor SQ initiation & network isolation options

Hi Oliver / Erin —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on compliance and network posture for the FinServe pilot.

Summary of what we discussed:
- Deployment modes you are evaluating: VPC-hosted Redwood Private (customer VPC peering), dedicated on-prem appliance (air-gapped option possible), and a managed private instance in your cloud account.
- Compliance drivers: SOC 2 Type II evidence required for vendor onboarding; potential HIPAA scope for transaction flows (you requested confirmation of BAA options).
- Network requirements: strict egress controls, optional physical air-gap for isolated test environment, and diagram of network boundaries requested by your security team.

Action items (owner / ETA):
1) FinServe to share vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) PDF and procurement contact (Oliver / procurement@finserve.com) — ACTION: FinServe — by 2026-02-26
2) Redwood to share SOC 2 artifact summary (redacted) and BAA template — ACTION: Dylan — by 2026-02-27
3) Redwood security to initiate VSQ intake and provide a secure intake link for attachments + request a network diagram template — ACTION: Sergio — by 2026-02-27
4) Technical deep-dive on private deployment networking and air-gap feasibility (30–45m) — schedule for week of 3/1 — ACTION: Marissa to coordinate

What we can share now:
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified; I will attach the SOC 2 summary and our BAA template. We support HIPAA-covered workflows with the Private deployment and an executed BAA.
- Air-gapped on-prem option: we have an on-prem package that can be deployed in a fully isolated environment; it requires an initial secure bundle for model assets and periodic updates via controlled media or an approved jump host.
- For VPC deployments we support either VPC peering or PrivateLink-style connectivity plus strict security groups and NAT/egress lock-down controls.

Attached: redwood-network-diagram-template.pdf (simple template your security team can fill), vendor-sq-intake-link.txt (one-time secure upload link we'll use for questionnaire PDF).

Let me know a good time for the technical deep-dive and if procurement needs a separate thread.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Oliver Wang <oliver.wang@finserve.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Chen <erin.chen@finserve.com>, procurement@finserve.com
Date: 2026-02-26 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: Private deployment, vendor SQ initiation & network isolation options

Thanks Dylan — good summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@finserve.com (please loop them for contract/PO terms).
- Security ask: we need to complete our vendor security questionnaire (attached as FinServe_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf). Our security lead will want to review SOC 2 artifacts and the network diagram before approval.
- HIPAA: some of the pilot data will be PHI; please confirm you can support a HIPAA BAA and whether there are additional controls required for the air-gapped deployment.

We can aim to return the filled VSQ by 2026-03-03 pending a couple clarifications on data residency. Would appreciate the SOC 2 summary and the BAA draft. Also please propose a time for the technical deep-dive next week; Thursday afternoon would work for our infra team.

Oliver
Head of IT Security, FinServe Inc.
Mobile: +1 (212) 555-0199

--Attached: FinServe_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf--
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-26 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: FinServe SQ and next steps (intake)

Forwarding FinServe's questionnaire. I'll set up the VSQ intake in our secure portal and create a ticket in security intake. Plan:

- Create secure upload link and request initial deliverables (filled VSQ PDF, network diagram, SOC 2 redacted report).
- Assign to Lindsay (security ops) to validate VSQ answers and flag any control gaps (especially re: air gap procedures and PHI handling).
- If any high-risk items show up, we loop in Product for deployment changes.

I'll post the secure intake link and the ticket number in this thread once ready. Marissa, can you line up a 30m technical deep dive Thursday 2026-03-04 14:00 PT (ours) / 17:00 ET (theirs)? If that works I'll send invite.

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Wang <oliver.wang@finserve.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@finserve.com
Date: 2026-02-28 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Private deployment, vendor SQ initiation & network isolation options

Oliver — thanks for the questionnaire. Quick updates: 

- SOC 2: attaching a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary and our standard BAA draft (see attachments). We can provide full SOC 2 artifact under NDA if needed.
- Vendor SQ intake: Sergio has created the secure intake portal and the upload link is available here: https://redwood.app/sec-intake/VSQ-FS-041 (one-time token). Please upload the filled VSQ and your network diagram there.
- Air-gap notes: our on-prem package supports physical air-gap. Key constraints to highlight for planning: initial model bundle transfer must be via encrypted media or controlled jump host; updates require scheduled approved windows. We'll review the specifics in the technical deep-dive.

Proposed next steps:
1) FinServe uploads the filled VSQ + network diagram to the secure intake link by 2026-03-03.
2) We exchange the redacted SOC 2 and BAA (attached) — please confirm any legal edits.
3) Technical deep-dive: 2026-03-04 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET — invite pending confirmation.

If procurement needs a separate line item for the on-prem / air-gap packaging and ongoing maintenance, Marissa will follow up with pricing.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-network-diagram-template.pdf, redacted-soc2-summary.pdf, BAA-draft-redwood.docx
